If $f$ is strictly prime-power monotonic, then the least positive period of $G_{f}$ is

 $\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\mid c\\
p\nmid A\end{subarray}}p^{v_{p}(c)}\prod\limits_{\begin{subarray}{c}p\mid L\\
p\nmid A\\
v_{p}(L)>v_{p}(k+1)\end{subarray}}p^{v_{p}(L)}.$

open scoped BigOperators

lemma x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux1 (g : ℕ → ℂ) (hg : Function.Injective g)
    (hnz : ∀ m, g m ≠ 0) (d c l v : ℕ) :
    ((Finset.Icc 1 l).filter (fun j => v < j ∧
      g (d + c + j) / g (d + c + j - 1) ≠ 1)).sup id =
      if v < l then l else 0 := by
  classical
  have hratio (j : ℕ) (hj : 0 < j) :
      g (d + c + j) / g (d + c + j - 1) ≠ 1 := by
    intro h
    have he := hg ((div_eq_one_iff_eq (hnz _)).mp h)
    omega
  by_cases h : v < l
  · rw [if_pos h]
    apply le_antisymm
    · apply Finset.sup_le
      intro j hj
      exact (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2
    · exact Finset.le_sup (f := id) (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
        ⟨Finset.mem_Icc.mpr ⟨by omega, le_rfl⟩, h, hratio l (by omega)⟩)
  · rw [if_neg h]
    apply Finset.sup_eq_zero.mpr
    intro j hj
    have h1 := (Finset.mem_Icc.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1).2
    have h2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.1
    omega

lemma x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux2 (g : ℕ → ℝ) (hpos : ∀ m, 0 < g m)
    (hmono : StrictMono g ∨ StrictAnti g) (k d c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hc : 0 < c)
    (s : Finset ℕ) (hs : ∀ j ∈ s, 0 < j) (w : ℕ → ℕ) :
    g (d + c - 1) ^ k ≠ g (d + c) ^ k *
      ∏ j ∈ s, (g (d + c + j) / g (d + c + j - 1)) ^ w j := by
  rcases hmono with hm | hm
  · have hpow : g (d + c - 1) ^ k < g (d + c) ^ k :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ (hm (by omega)) (hpos _).le (by omega)
    have hp : 1 ≤ ∏ j ∈ s,
        (g (d + c + j) / g (d + c + j - 1)) ^ w j := by
      apply Finset.one_le_prod
      intro j hj
      apply one_le_pow₀
      apply (one_le_div (hpos _)).mpr
      exact (hm (by have := hs j hj; omega)).le
    have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (pow_pos (hpos (d + c)) k).le
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    exact ne_of_lt (hpow.trans_le hle)
  · have hpow : g (d + c) ^ k < g (d + c - 1) ^ k :=
      pow_lt_pow_left₀ (hm (by omega)) (hpos _).le (by omega)
    have hp : (∏ j ∈ s,
        (g (d + c + j) / g (d + c + j - 1)) ^ w j) ≤ 1 := by
      apply Finset.prod_le_one
      · intro j hj
        exact pow_nonneg (div_pos (hpos _) (hpos _)).le _
      · intro j hj
        apply pow_le_one₀ (div_pos (hpos _) (hpos _)).le
        apply (div_le_one (hpos _)).mpr
        exact (hm (by have := hs j hj; omega)).le
    have hle := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (pow_pos (hpos (d + c)) k).le
    rw [mul_one] at hle
    exact ne_of_gt (hle.trans_lt hpow)

lemma x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux3 (g : ℕ → ℂ) (K : ℂ) (c : ℕ)
    (h : 0 < c → g (c - 1) ≠ K) :
    ((Finset.range c).filter (fun j => g j ≠ K)).sup (fun j => j + 1) = c := by
  classical
  apply le_antisymm
  · apply Finset.sup_le
    intro j hj
    have := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).1
    omega
  · by_cases hc : 0 < c
    · have hmem : c - 1 ∈ (Finset.range c).filter (fun j => g j ≠ K) :=
        Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega), h hc⟩
      have H := Finset.le_sup (f := fun j => j + 1) hmem
      omega
    · omega

lemma x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux4 (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (hc : 0 < c)
    (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < f n)
    (hmono : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p →
      StrictMono (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m)) ∨ StrictAnti (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m))) :
    x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c (fun n => (f n : ℂ)) =
      x2611_15379_monotonicPeriod k a b c := by
  classical
  let d := Nat.gcd a b
  let A := a / d
  let L := Nat.lcmUpto k
  let R : ℕ → ℕ → ℂ := fun p j =>
    (f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p + j)) : ℂ) /
      (f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p + j - 1)) : ℂ)
  let M : ℕ → ℕ := fun p =>
    ((Finset.Icc 1 (L.factorization p)).filter
      (fun j => (k + 1).factorization p < j ∧ R p j ≠ 1)).sup id
  let K : ℕ → ℂ := fun p =>
    (f (p ^ (d.factorization p + c.factorization p)) : ℂ) ^ k *
      ∏ j ∈ Finset.Icc 1 (min (L.factorization p) ((k + 1).factorization p)),
        R p j ^ ((k + 1) / p ^ j - 1)
  let e : ℕ → ℕ := fun p =>
    if 0 < M p then c.factorization p + M p
    else ((Finset.range (c.factorization p)).filter
      (fun j => (f (p ^ (d.factorization p + j)) : ℂ) ^ k ≠ K p)).sup (fun j => j + 1)
  have hM (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
      M p = if (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p then L.factorization p else 0 := by
    apply x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux1 (fun m => (f (p ^ m) : ℂ))
    · intro x y h
      have he : f (p ^ x) = f (p ^ y) := Complex.ofReal_injective h
      rcases hmono p hp with hm | hm
      · exact hm.injective he
      · exact hm.injective he
    · intro m
      exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hpos _ (pow_pos hp.pos _)))
  have he (p : ℕ) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
      e p = c.factorization p +
        if (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p then L.factorization p else 0 := by
    by_cases hlt : (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p
    · have hMp : 0 < M p := by rw [hM p hp, if_pos hlt]; omega
      simp only [e, if_pos hMp, hM p hp, if_pos hlt]
    · have hMp : M p = 0 := by rw [hM p hp, if_neg hlt]
      simp only [e, hMp, lt_self_iff_false, ↓reduceIte, if_neg hlt, Nat.add_zero]
      apply x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux3
      intro hcp
      have hne := x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux2 (fun m => f (p ^ m))
        (fun m => hpos _ (pow_pos hp.pos m)) (hmono p hp) k
        (d.factorization p) (c.factorization p) hk hcp
        (Finset.Icc 1 (min (L.factorization p) ((k + 1).factorization p)))
        (fun j hj => (Finset.mem_Icc.mp hj).1) (fun j => (k + 1) / p ^ j - 1)
      intro hEq
      apply hne
      have hsub : d.factorization p + (c.factorization p - 1) =
          d.factorization p + c.factorization p - 1 := by omega
      change (f (p ^ (d.factorization p + (c.factorization p - 1))) : ℂ) ^ k = K p at hEq
      rw [hsub] at hEq
      simpa only [K, R, ← Complex.ofReal_pow, ← Complex.ofReal_div,
        ← Complex.ofReal_prod, ← Complex.ofReal_mul, Complex.ofReal_inj] using hEq
  let U := (c * L).primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A)
  let S := c.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A)
  let V := L.primeFactors.filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A ∧
    (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p)
  have hU : U = (c.primeFactors ∪ L.primeFactors).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ A) := by
    dsimp [U]
    rw [Nat.primeFactors_mul (Nat.ne_of_gt hc) (Nat.lcmUpto_ne_zero k)]
  have hSU : S ⊆ U := by
    rw [hU]
    intro p hp
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_union_left _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2⟩
  have hVU : V ⊆ U := by
    rw [hU]
    intro p hp
    exact Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_union_right _ (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1,
      (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.1⟩
  have hprod1 : (∏ p ∈ U, p ^ c.factorization p) = ∏ p ∈ S, p ^ c.factorization p := by
    symm
    apply Finset.prod_subset hSU
    intro p hp hnot
    have hnd : ¬ p ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
    have hpf : p ∉ c.primeFactors := by
      intro hpf
      exact hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr ⟨hpf, hnd⟩)
    have hpprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
    have hnc : ¬ p ∣ c := fun hd => hpf (hpprime.mem_primeFactors hd (Nat.ne_of_gt hc))
    simp [Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hnc]
  have hprod2 : (∏ p ∈ U, p ^
      (if (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p then L.factorization p else 0)) =
      ∏ p ∈ V, p ^ L.factorization p := by
    calc
      _ = ∏ p ∈ V, p ^
          (if (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p then L.factorization p else 0) := by
        symm
        apply Finset.prod_subset hVU
        intro p hp hnot
        by_cases hlt : (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p
        · have hpprime := Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1
          have hnd : ¬ p ∣ A := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2
          have hLp : p ∣ L := by
            by_contra hLp
            have := Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hLp
            omega
          exact False.elim (hnot (Finset.mem_filter.mpr
            ⟨hpprime.mem_primeFactors hLp (Nat.lcmUpto_ne_zero k), hnd, hlt⟩))
        · simp [hlt]
      _ = _ := Finset.prod_congr rfl (fun p hp => by
          rw [if_pos (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).2.2])
  change (∏ p ∈ U, p ^ e p) = _
  calc
    _ = ∏ p ∈ U, p ^ c.factorization p * p ^
        (if (k + 1).factorization p < L.factorization p then L.factorization p else 0) := by
      apply Finset.prod_congr rfl
      intro p hp
      rw [he p (Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors (Finset.mem_filter.mp hp).1), pow_add]
    _ = (∏ p ∈ S, p ^ c.factorization p) * ∏ p ∈ V, p ^ L.factorization p := by
      rw [Finset.prod_mul_distrib, hprod1, hprod2]
    _ = _ := rfl

theorem x2611_15379_cor1_1 (k a b c : ℕ) (hk : 0 < k) (ha : 0 < a) (hc : 0 < c)
    (f : ArithmeticFunction ℝ) (hf : f.IsMultiplicative)
    (hpos : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → 0 < f n)
    (hmono : ∀ p : ℕ, Nat.Prime p →
      StrictMono (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m)) ∨ StrictAnti (fun m : ℕ => f (p ^ m))) :
    IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
      (x2611_15379_G k a b c (fun n => (f n : ℂ))) (n + T) =
        (x2611_15379_G k a b c (fun n => (f n : ℂ))) n}
      (x2611_15379_monotonicPeriod k a b c) := by
  have main : ∀ (k a b c : ℕ), 0 < k → 0 < a → 0 < c →
      ∀ (f : ArithmeticFunction ℂ), f.IsMultiplicative →
      (∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → f n ≠ 0) →
      IsLeast {T : ℕ | 0 < T ∧ ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n →
        x2611_15379_G k a b c f (n + T) = x2611_15379_G k a b c f n}
        (x2611_15379_periodFormula k a b c f) := by
    clear k a b c hk ha hc f hf hpos hmono
    sorry
  let F : ArithmeticFunction ℂ := ⟨fun n => (f n : ℂ), by simp⟩
  have hF : F.IsMultiplicative := by
    constructor
    · change (f 1 : ℂ) = 1
      rw [hf.map_one, Complex.ofReal_one]
    · intro m n hmn
      change (f (m * n) : ℂ) = (f m : ℂ) * (f n : ℂ)
      rw [hf.map_mul_of_coprime hmn, Complex.ofReal_mul]
  have hnz : ∀ n : ℕ, 0 < n → F n ≠ 0 := by
    intro n hn
    exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (hpos n hn))
  have h := main k a b c hk ha hc F hF hnz
  rw [← x2611_15379_cor1_1_aux4 k a b c hk hc f hpos hmono]
  exact h
